evidence.reason: DEPENDENCY_RE is the dependency scan used to detect co-installed unit relationships that can affect the selected crq unit. Systemd v257, referenced in this file, defines PropagatesStopTo= and StopPropagatedFrom= as [Unit] stop-propagation directives. Omitting both means a co-installed unit such as backup.service with PropagatesStopTo=crq-tick.service can stop crq-tick.service without being recognized, allowing discovery to report supported=True. This is an implementation gap in existing dependency detection, not a new requirement.
